# Plan: Build the network map and post-episode exploration

## Sources

`docs/game-design.md` "After the episode". `src/content/schema.ts` has `sectorSchema` (`position`, `description`, `visibleWhen`, `enterableWhen`, `lockedText`, `grantsOnEnter`). `src/app/tools.ts` builds tools. `src/puzzle/evaluate.ts` handles `code` puzzles. `src/world/archive-view.ts` opens the message base.

## Content

- `content/sectors/relay-07.json`: `visibleWhen: completed:episode.000`. Enterable. `grantsOnEnter: discovered:relay-07`. Linked panel puzzle `puzzle.service`.
- `content/sectors/the-archive.json`: visible from the same point. Opens the message base (`opens: archive`).
- `content/sectors/silent-observatory.json`: visible, `enterableWhen` a flag that nothing in Day 0 can grant is not allowed by the validator, so it uses `{ "not": "completed:episode.000" }`, which is always false once it is visible. `lockedText` starts `NO CARRIER` and says that it answers to more than one Observer. This is an authored hook with a clear in-world reason.
- `content/puzzles/service-panel.json` (`code`), not in the episode's puzzle list, so it stays optional. `requires: completed:episode.000`. Answer `709`. Grants `flag:service-panel-open`.
- `content/archives/`: `lore.meter-trace` (requires `completed:episode.000`, ordinary): the Relay 07 meter's repeating dips printed as three 3-by-5 survey marks reading 7-0-9 under Rev C (4-0-9 under Rev A, which fails). Plus at least two lore entries.
- `content/characters/echo.json`: an optional-discovery hint and reactions for entering a location and for opening the panel.

## Engine

- `schema.ts`: add to sectors optional `opens` (`archive`) and optional `puzzle` (id). `validate.ts` checks the reference.
- `src/world/map.ts` (pure): `mapNodes(sectors, facts)` returns visible sectors with `enterable`, using `evaluate`.
- `src/world/map-view.ts`: `openMap(panel, nodes, onSelect)`: positioned native buttons over a starfield with SVG link lines. Arrow-free: Tab and Enter work because they are buttons. Each node shows its name and state.
- `src/world/sector-view.ts`: `enterSector`: prints description or locked text; if enterable and `opens: archive`, opens the message base; if enterable with `puzzle`, shows a `SERVICE CODE` form using `game.attempt`.
- `src/app/tools.ts`: a `NETWORK MAP` tool, offered once any sector is visible. Its code path is driven by sector content, not by ids.
- `src/app/ending.ts`/`main.ts`: no change beyond the hub showing the new tool. The ending's `CONTINUE` returns to the hub where the tool appears, and the boot prompt for a returning player is unchanged.

## Files

New: the content above, `src/world/{map,map-view,sector-view}.ts`, `tests/unit/world.test.ts`, `tests/e2e/map.spec.ts`. Changed: `src/content/{schema,validate}.ts`, `tests/unit/content.test.ts`, `src/app/tools.ts`, `src/style.css`, `content/characters/echo.json`.

## Out of scope

FORGE. The panel's success text only says what is behind the panel; the FORGE terminal is the next WorkUnit.

# Test plan

Local commands: `npx vitest run tests/unit/world.test.ts tests/unit/content.test.ts`, `npm run lint`. Browser evidence comes from the PR's `Browser tests` workflow, which runs `tests/e2e/map.spec.ts`. Developer and tester may complete with browser evidence pending CI.

| Acceptance criterion | Verification | Owner |
| --- | --- | --- |
| A new map node appears after the episode; all three show their content-defined state; keyboard-operable | `world.test.ts`: `mapNodes` returns none before completion and three after, with `enterable` matching content. `map.spec.ts`, from a real completion: tool absent beforehand; three nodes present; each operated by keyboard focus and Enter | Developer; CI |
| Relay 07 explorable, The Archive has lore, Observatory answers NO CARRIER | `map.spec.ts`: entering each shows the expected content and `discovered:relay-07` persists; `world.test.ts`: Observatory never enterable under the reachable fact set; lore entries unlock only after completion | Developer; CI |
| Optional discovery solvable from in-game evidence, persists, tested | `world.test.ts`: parses the marks from `lore.meter-trace` with the real Rev C table to get `709`, Rev A gives `409` and is refused, and episode completion does not need it. `map.spec.ts`: entering the code solves it, and it stays solved after reload | Developer; CI |

`content.test.ts` covers the new sector fields: valid, and an unknown puzzle reference reported with file and field.

## Roles

- **Developer:** runs the local commands above.
- **Tester:** independently inspects source and content against the criteria and `docs/game-design.md`, reuses applicable passing results, repeats only for relevant changes, failures, or unresolved coverage.
- **Coordinator:** alone runs the complete required policy.

VERDICT: APPROVED

| Contract area | Audit |
| --- | --- |
| Objective and post-episode map | Three content-defined locations, completion-gated visibility, and a hub map tool cover post-episode exploration. Existing `src/main.ts` returns from the ending to the hub as claimed. |
| Mystery facts and Observatory constraint | Proposed recovered relay, additional archive lore, and unreachable Observatory with `NO CARRIER` and the multiple-Observer explanation match `docs/game-design.md`. The visibility/entry conditions make the Observatory inspectable but never enterable while visible. |
| Acceptance 1 | Pure visibility/state tests plus a real-completion browser journey covering keyboard activation of all three nodes provide focused coverage. |
| Acceptance 2 | Browser checks cover location content and relay discovery persistence; unit checks cover Observatory gating and lore availability. |
| Acceptance 3 | Tests derive the service code from authored marks using the actual manual, reject the obsolete revision, verify optionality, and check persistence after reload. Existing manuals support the proposed 709/409 distinction. |
| Evidence and implementation feasibility | Verified the cited sector fields, condition evaluation, ungranted-flag validation, code-puzzle evaluation, archive UI, and tool construction in source. `REVIEW_EVIDENCE.md` repeats the proposed artifacts and contains no additional reports or unmerged lessons. |
| Scope and conventions | Engine behavior remains content-driven; proposed files avoid protected paths and introduce no dependencies. FORGE integration remains a separate WorkUnit; the scoped optional panel discovery is covered here. |
| Verification ownership | Focused developer commands, independent tester review/reuse, coordinator-owned required checks, and browser CI follow the approved execution profile and sandbox restrictions. |

No required revisions. Browser acceptance evidence remains pending the PR's Browser tests workflow; this plan review does not certify implementation or test results.
